fit_reason: This is a new outboard engine only, listed by a dealer (Riverview Sports and Marine), not a whole boat from a private owner. The photos are a manufacturer stock image and logos.
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Yamaha outboard. We do pre-sale detailing and gelcoat polishing for boats and come to you, so if you ever have a boat to sell that could use some cleanup, we'd be glad to give you a quote.
